name: bambu-live-view
title: Bambu Live View
description: Tiny always-on-top live camera view of your Bambu Lab 3D printer, streamed over your local network with mpv.
author: girr_paan

commands.name: setup-printer
commands.title: Printer Setup
commands.subtitle: Bambu Live View
commands.description: Step-by-step guide to enable LAN liveview, install mpv, save your printer's IP and access code, and test the connection.

commands.name: toggle-live-view
commands.title: Toggle Live View
commands.subtitle: Bambu Live View
commands.description: Open or close a small always-on-top window with your printer's live camera.

preferences.name: size
preferences.title: Window Size
preferences.description: Size of the live view window.

preferences.name: corner
preferences.title: Window Position
preferences.description: Screen corner the live view window opens in.

preferences.name: windowTitle
preferences.title: Window Title
preferences.description: Title of the mpv window (shown in Mission Control and the window switcher).

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the `prepublishOnly` script and rerun `npm publish` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use `npm run publish` instead.

" && exit 1
